formatCurrency

Function to format monetary values with proper currency display using Intl.NumberFormat.

Example
import formatCurrency from '@/utils/formatCurrency'

// Basic usage
formatCurrency(1234.56)
// output: '$1,235'

// With decimals
formatCurrency(1234.56, 'USD', 'en-US', 2)
// output: '$1,234.56'

// Different currency
formatCurrency(1234.56, 'EUR', 'de-DE', 2)
// output: '1.234,56 €'

// Japanese Yen
formatCurrency(1234, 'JPY', 'ja-JP')
// output: '¥1,234'

Params
PARAM	DESCRIPTION	TYPE	DEFAULT
value	The numeric value to format.	number	-
currency	The currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).	string	'USD'
locale	The locale for formatting.	string	'en-US'
decimals	Number of decimal places.	number	0
Return
RETURN	DESCRIPTION	TYPE	DEFAULT
formattedCurrency	The formatted currency string.	string	-
